notes: Version 2.50 records white paper 3.15, a scientific correction of Appendices A.9 and A.10. The fibre-to-base curvature relation (Proposition A.2) is restated as a conditional Kaluza–Klein identity between Ricci tensors, under hypotheses that are not derived: a connection metric with an Ad-invariant fibre inner product, the identification of the effective metric with its base metric, and a field equation on the total space for a sourcing reading; its earlier derivation from the Hessian metric is withdrawn. Appendix A.10 withdraws a sub-principal-symbol argument for the infrared Einstein–Hilbert term: the R/6 term belongs to the a2 heat-kernel coefficient, the bundle and base curvatures are not related without an explicit construction, and the required operator-level construction is stated as missing, not as excluded. Theorem A.1 and Corollary A.1 are unchanged, and the necessity of a non-injective projection still rests on the ENI no-go theorem alone. No theorem of another paper, numerical result, status, graph node or edge changes.
